reviews.text:
My dog ​​was ill, and I took him to this hospital seeking help, but they refused to even examine him because they weren't accepting new patients.

Even with a distressed animal right in front of me, I was turned away simply because I was a new patient. Honestly, I was furious and saddened.

If they're not accepting new patients, they should make that clearer beforehand. I wish they'd consider how pet owners feel when they bring their sick dogs to a hospital only to be turned away.

Those considering visiting this hospital should be aware: they are currently not accepting new patients.

If you go expecting a veterinary hospital to treat animals in distress, you might be turned away like I was. This experience strongly reinforced my feeling that this hospital won't help dogs in need.

My dog ​​suddenly developed severe abdominal pain and diarrhea, but our regular vet was closed, so I rushed him to this clinic out of desperation. I was turned away at the door, told they weren't accepting new patients and to go somewhere else.

It seems they have no intention of helping dogs or their owners in distress due to sudden illness.

Actually, I was glad I didn't have to go to such a vet.

I always bring my cat in for shampooing.

Every time, they do a beautiful job, and they even trim her claws into a cute, rounded shape, so I'm always very satisfied. They also take great care of her chin acne, which is a huge help.

You can tell that the vet and nurses all love animals, so I feel completely at ease leaving my cat in their care. Thank you for always being so kind and attentive!

This happened several years ago, but I still can't accept it, so I decided to write this. First of all, their attitude was intimidating. The examination was extremely haphazard; they grabbed the animal by the scruff of its neck and forced its mouth open, it was a complete mess. To top it all off, they just laughed and said, "Well, it'll be fine," and ended it there. As a result, my pet was terrified and completely withdrawn. I've seen many veterinarians, but this was probably the worst and most malicious. I doubt they even have any sense of responsibility as a veterinarian, and I haven't gone back since, which I think was the right decision.

I've been going to this vet for three times because I like the doctor's personality, and I had my cat's claws trimmed, but two of my paws bled. My cat was crying loudly and seemed to be in pain. The vet didn't apologize and just laughed it off. I'm really shocked because I really liked this vet.
They are trustworthy teachers and staff.

I used to go there.

I skimmed through the reviews, but I don't understand why they're so bad lol

Certainly, the doctor might seem cold at first glance, but he's very kind to animals, and he's a doctor who can properly scold owners who are raising their pets incorrectly. I think he's a very trustworthy doctor.

Just like with doctors who treat humans,
I don't think a good doctor is someone who is always smiling and kind and uses polite language with pet owners.

Even if he's a little harsh, I think he's a doctor who will properly examine your pet. (^^)

When I told them I was a beginner and just starting to own a dog, they were very sensible and quoted me 10,000 yen for the eight-in-one vaccine and 15,000 yen for the rabies vaccine. Other hospitals quoted me 8,000 yen for the ten-in-one vaccine and 5,000 yen for the rabies vaccine, including consultation. I wouldn't recommend this place to beginners or those unfamiliar with prices. It was a privately owned store, so it might be a good choice for regulars or those with more knowledge. I prefer friendly stores. It's a good idea to contact several hospitals when choosing one. Thank you for your information.
